name: AUM Lalitayai Namah
meaning: I offer salutations to Lalita, the graceful and sovereign Goddess.
purpose: A simple devotional salutation to Lalita.
supports: Self-respect; dignity; appreciation of beauty; balanced pleasure.
when: During a contemplative practice centred on grace and self-worth.
note: A simple nama-style formula, not a substitute for lineage-specific Śrīvidyā mantras.
